_comment: The pillars of the prayer as al-Quduri lists them, one card each, in the order they are done. Every quote is his sentence as written (tests/test_grow.py holds it to the book).
title: Pillars of the prayer

quote.arabic: فإذا دخل الرجل في الصلاة كبر ورفع يديه مع التكبير حتى يحاذى بإبهاميه شحمتي أذنيه
quote.english: When a man enters the prayer he says the takbir and raises his hands with it until his thumbs are level with his earlobes.

quote.arabic: فرائض الصلاة ستة: التحريمة والقيام والقرءة والركوع والسجود والقعدة الأخيرة مقدار التشهد
quote.english: The obligations of the prayer are six: the opening takbir, standing, reciting, ruku', sujud, and the last sitting for the length of the tashahhud.

quote.arabic: ثم يكبر ويركع ويعتمد بيديه على ركبتيه ويفرج أصابعه ويبسط ظهره ولا يرفع رأسه ولا ينكسه
quote.english: Then he says the takbir and bows, resting his hands on his knees, spreading his fingers and flattening his back, neither raising his head nor lowering it.

quote.arabic: واعتمد بيديه على الأرض ووضع وجهه بين كفيه وسجد على أنفه وجبهته
quote.english: He rests his hands on the ground, puts his face between his palms, and prostrates on his nose and forehead.
